**Big, but mostly mechanical: 94 files, and three spots must not be touched.**

Scope: `account_id` shows up across all five services (accounts, orders, billing, notify, analytics) in repo/service/http layers, plus `lib/audit.js`, `lib/serialize.js`, `docs/openapi.yaml`, and 12 migration files.

Do not rename in:

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` | Vendored third-party copy, overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh` — edits are lost, patch upstream instead |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` map, `docs/openapi.yaml` | Public API field, explicitly frozen by contract — comments say renaming breaks every client |
| `migrations/*.sql` (already applied, e.g. `20250114_create_accounts.sql`) | History — editing doesn't rename anything in prod, breaks the `down` step |

Safe to rename: internal DB column via a **new** migration, plus all internal repo/service/route code that maps to it — just keep serializing it back out as `account_id` at the API boundary.

Next: confirm with platform team whether this is internal-only or also meant to change the public field, since the openapi contract says that needs a new dated API version.
